name: What are common plumbing issues during kitchen remodels?
description: Common plumbing issues during kitchen remodels involve pipe deterioration, drain line relocation difficulties, water pressure problems, and venting challenges.

mainEntity.name: What are common plumbing issues during kitchen remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common plumbing issues during kitchen remodels include unexpected pipe deterioration when opening walls, difficulties in relocating drain lines due to structural elements, inadequate water pressure for new fixtures, and incorrect sizing of new supply lines. It's also common to encounter challenges with venting systems, especially when changing the layout or adding new appliances like dishwashers and garbage disposals. Addressing these early with a professional plumber helps prevent major problems.
